sourceText: …I’m quite sure.

targetText: <style=Thought>(Kuna utulivu kumhusu. Kuna jambo katika uwepo wake linalonipa utulivu.)</style>

sourceText: …! <style=Thought>(He’s looking right at me!)</style>
targetText: …! <style=Thought>(Ananitazama moja kwa moja!)</style>

targetText: <style=Thought>(Anaonekana ana wasiwasi kuhusu jambo fulani.)</style>

sourceText: Sorry sir, is not everything to your liking?
targetText: Samahani bwana, si kila kitu kinakupendeza?

targetText: <style=Thought>(Si kwamba amekosea, lakini bado kwa namna fulani nimeudhika...?)</style>

sourceText: Ok, everyone! Time for me to read out everyone’s roles for the murder mystery!
targetText: Sawa, kila mtu! Wakati umefika nisome nafasi za kila mtu kwa ajili ya fumbo la mauaji!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: <style=Thought>(To be honest, this group seems plenty capable on their own.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Kusema kweli, kundi hili linaonekana lina uwezo wa kutosha lenyewe.)</style>

sourceText: if they need any help, won’t you?

targetText: <style=Thought>(Hakuna kitu cha kupasha moyo zaidi ya kondakta na treni yake…)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Goodbye now!
targetText: Kwaheri sasa!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Thank you all for following the outfit guide I sent you, you all look amazing. I trust you all read your lore cards as well?
targetText: Asanteni nyote kwa kufuata mwongozo wa mavazi niliowatumia, mnaonekana vizuri sana. Ninaamini pia mmesoma kadi zenu za historia?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Lore cards? That must be the details of their motivations.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Kadi za historia? Lazima ziwe maelezo ya misukumo yao.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Now on to the nitty gritty. For the murder mystery game one of you will be murdered, and the rest suspects!
targetText: Sasa kwenye mambo muhimu. Katika mchezo wa fumbo la mauaji, mmoja wenu atauawa, na wengine mtakuwa watuhumiwa!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Everyone has assigned roles for characters they will be playing. Participation is required, for it is my birthday.
targetText: Kila mtu amepewa nafasi ya wahusika atakaowacheza. Kushiriki ni lazima, kwa sababu ni siku yangu ya kuzaliwa.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Birthday girl makes the rules.
targetText: Msichana wa siku ya kuzaliwa ndiye huweka sheria.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Sonic, you are a <style=Important>ship captain</style>, and you’ll be stationed in the  <style=CarName>conductor car</style>.
targetText: Sonic, wewe ni <style=Important>nahodha wa meli</style>, na utawekwa kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kondakta</style>.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Tails, you are the <style=Important>detective</style>! You’ll be here in the <style=CarName>dining car</style>.
targetText: Tails, wewe ni <style=Important>mpelelezi</style>! Utakuwa hapa kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kulia chakula</style>.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Knuckles, you’re the <style=Important>sheriff</style> around these parts. We’ll find you in the <style=CarName>saloon</style>.
targetText: Knuckles, wewe ni <style=Important>sherifu</style> wa maeneo haya. Tutakupata kwenye <style=CarName>gari la salooni</style>.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Rouge you’re a <style=Important>business tycoon</style>, and Blaze you’re a <style=Important>titan of industry</style>, both in the <style=CarName>casino</style>.
targetText: Rouge, wewe ni <style=Important>tajiri wa biashara</style>, na Blaze, wewe ni <style=Important>nguli wa viwanda</style>; nyote wawili mko kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kasino</style>.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: What’s the difference?
targetText: Tofauti ni nini?
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: There is none.
targetText: Hakuna.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Hmm, sounds fun.
targetText: Hmm, inasikika vizuri.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Vector, you’re the <style=Important>butcher</style>, and Espio the <style=Important>poet</style>, both found in the <style=CarName>library</style>.
targetText: Vector, wewe ni <style=Important>mchinjaji</style>, na Espio ni <style=Important>mshairi</style>, wote mko kwenye <style=CarName>maktaba</style>.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Shadow is the <style=Important>locksmith</style> hanging out in the <style=CarName>lounge</style>.
targetText: Shadow ni <style=Important>fundi wa kufuli</style> anayekaa kwenye <style=CarName>gari la mapumziko</style>.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: And, last but not least, me! The <style=Important>journalist reporter</style>! I’ll be moseying around with everyone.
targetText: Na mwisho kabisa, mimi! <style=Important>mwandishi wa habari</style>! Nitazunguka pamoja na kila mtu.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Did you get all that?
targetText: Umeelewa yote hayo?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: More than alright, you can help ensure everyone’s following their roles. Oh! That reminds me-
targetText: Zaidi ya sawa, unaweza kusaidia kuhakikisha kila mtu anafuata nafasi yake. Lo! Hilo limenikumbusha-
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I have a map for each of you!
targetText: Nina ramani kwa ajili ya kila mmoja wenu!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Alright, let me go over this again!
targetText: Sawa, nirudie jambo hili tena!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: The rules of the game are as follows: There is a murderer amongst you all!
targetText: Sheria za mchezo ni hizi: Kuna muuaji miongoni mwenu!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: The murderer can ‘kill’ a single participant however they choose, but you must physically be present with the victim for it to count.
targetText: Muuaji anaweza ‘kumuua’ mshiriki mmoja kwa njia yoyote atakayo, lakini lazima uwepo kimwili pamoja na mwathiriwa ili ihesabiwe.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Everyone else must collect evidence throughout the train, and use it to interrogate fellow passengers to figure out who done it.
targetText: Wengine wote lazima wakusanye ushahidi kote kwenye treni, na kuutumia kuwahoji abiria wenzao ili kubaini nani amefanya hivyo.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: The murderer will lie to get out of being accused, so inspect everything you can! Find <style=Important>clues</style>! And <style=Important>interrogate</style>!
targetText: Muuaji atasema uongo ili asishutumiwe, kwa hiyo chunguza kila kitu uwezacho! Tafuta <style=Important>vidokezo</style>! Na <style=Important>hoji</style>!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I’ll set a timer for one hour so everyone can mingle, and the murderer can do their thing. Is everyone ready?
targetText: Nitaweka kipima muda cha saa moja ili kila mtu achangamane, na muuaji afanye jambo lake. Kila mtu yuko tayari?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Everyone, to your stations!
targetText: Kila mtu, kwenye vituo vyenu!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: AAAAH, this is so exciting!
targetText: AAAAH, hii inasisimua sana!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: A mystery is unfolding right under our very noses.
targetText: Fumbo linajifunua mbele ya macho yetu.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: SAME! AAAH isn't it awesome!
targetText: MIMI PIA! AAAH, si jambo la ajabu!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Well actually, the detective and the journalist <style=Important>can’t be the murderer</style>.
targetText: Kwa kweli, mpelelezi na mwandishi wa habari <style=Important>hawawezi kuwa wauaji</style>.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: So we’re stuck here for an hour before going out and scoping the place.
targetText: Kwa hiyo tumekwama hapa kwa saa moja kabla ya kutoka na kukagua mahali.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Seems as though Amy’s more excited about deciphering the mystery anyways.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Inaonekana Amy ana msisimko zaidi wa kutegua fumbo hata hivyo.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Oh, probably inspecting their stations and talking amongst one another.
targetText: Pengine wanachunguza vituo vyao na kuzungumza wao kwa wao.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Everyone has roles to play so they must be exploring their characters.
targetText: Kila mtu ana nafasi ya kuigiza, kwa hiyo lazima wajifunze wahusika wao.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Do you know what their character motivations are, Amy?
targetText: Je, unajua motisha za wahusika wao, Amy?
speaker: Barry

sourceText: No, the lore cards are confidential! No one knows but the person who received them.
targetText: Hapana, kadi za historia ni za siri! Hakuna anayejua isipokuwa mtu aliyezopokea.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: My backstory is that I was best friends with a flicky that decided to join the evil Dr. Eggman, kickstarting my desire for justice in the world.
targetText: Hadithi yangu ya nyuma ni kwamba nilikuwa rafiki wa karibu wa Flicky mmoja aliyeamua kujiunga na Dkt. Eggman mwovu, jambo lililoanzisha hamu yangu ya kutafuta haki duniani.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: My lore is that I’m a nosey person turned journalist!
targetText: Historia yangu ni kwamba mimi ni mtu mdadisi aliyegeuka kuwa mwandishi wa habari!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: The train’s started moving!
targetText: Treni imeanza kusonga!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: H-Hold on!
targetText: S-Shikilia!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: No!
targetText: Hapana!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Library Car
targetText: Gari la maktaba

sourceText: Everyone’s favorite <style=Important>journalist reporter</style>, Amy Rose, is hot on the scoop!
targetText: Amy Rose, <style=Important>mwandishi wa habari</style> kipenzi cha kila mtu, anafuatilia habari motomoto!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I’m heading out, you’ve been fabulously helpful.
targetText: Naondoka; mmenisaidia sana.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: My <style=Important>presents</style>??
targetText: <style=Important>Zawadi</style> zangu??

sourceText: You’re both too sweet, thank you!
targetText: Nyinyi wawili ni watamu sana, asanteni!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Amy, there you are!
targetText: Amy, kumbe uko hapa!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Oh? The detective pair needs help from the birthday girl?
targetText: Lo? Wawili hao wapelelezi wanahitaji msaada wa msichana wa siku ya kuzaliwa?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Ah… she knows everyone’s allowed to be sassy on their birthday.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ah… anajua kila mtu anaruhusiwa kuwa na dharau kwenye siku yake ya kuzaliwa.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Flattered, but at the pace you two are going, Sonic’s murderer will never get found.
targetText: Nimefurahishwa, lakini kwa kasi mnayoenda ninyi wawili, muuaji wa Sonic hatapatikana kamwe.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Oh, she’s confident. She must have something up her sleeve.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Lo, ana ujasiri. Lazima awe na jambo analolificha.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: This tip is just too juicy to ignore, I’ll see you all around!
targetText: Dokezo hili ni motomoto mno kulipuuzia; tutaonana baadaye!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Don’t worry Sonic, I’ll be the one to avenge you. And quick!
targetText: Usijali Sonic, mimi ndiye nitakayekulipizia kisasi. Na haraka!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Oh, you doubt the birthday girl?
targetText: Lo, mnamtilia shaka msichana wa siku ya kuzaliwa?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: The birthday girl has a master key!
targetText: Msichana wa siku ya kuzaliwa ana ufunguo mkuu!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Right right, the birthday girl gets the birthday key.
targetText: Sawa sawa, msichana wa siku ya kuzaliwa anapata ufunguo wa siku ya kuzaliwa.

sourceText: I'll solve this case before anyone else! Byeee!
targetText: Nitatatua kesi hii kabla ya mtu mwingine yeyote! Kwaheriii!

sourceText: Amy may be hasty, but she’s thorough.
targetText: Amy anaweza kuwa na haraka, lakini ni makini.

sourceText: <style=Thought>(At least he’s rhyming, I suppose…)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Angalau anaweka vina, nadhani…)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Can you walk us through what happened after Amy had everyone leave the <style=CarName>dining car</style>?
targetText: Mnaweza kutuonyesha kilichotokea baada ya Amy kuwafanya wote waondoke kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kulia chakula</style>?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Oh sure, it’s simple! We just explained this to Amy, actually.
targetText: Lo bila shaka, ni rahisi! Kwa kweli tumemweleza Amy hili.
speaker: Vector

sourceText: When we were all sent off, Rouge, Blaze, Shadow, and Sonic all passed through this <style=CarName>library car</style>,
targetText: Tulipopelekwa wote, Rouge, Blaze, Shadow, na Sonic wote walipita kwenye <style=CarName>gari hili la maktaba</style>,
speaker: Vector

sourceText: ...where Amy told me and Espio to stay.
targetText: ...ambako Amy aliniambia mimi na Espio tubaki.
speaker: Vector

sourceText: Vector got bored, so he left to see what Knuckles was up to in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.
targetText: Vector alichoka, kwa hiyo aliondoka kuona Knuckles alikuwa akifanya nini kwenye <style=CarName>gari la salooni</style>.
speaker: Espio

sourceText: Where was Rouge? We happened to see her lipstick stain on a cup at the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.
targetText: Rouge alikuwa wapi? Tuliona doa la rangi yake ya midomo kwenye kikombe kwenye <style=CarName>gari la salooni</style>.

sourceText: Rouge came over to the <style=CarName>library car</style>, seemingly looking for something.
targetText: Rouge alikuja kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style>, akionekana kutafuta kitu.
speaker: Espio

sourceText: Then she went to search the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>.
targetText: Kisha akaenda kutafuta kwenye <style=CarName>gari la salooni</style>.
speaker: Espio

sourceText: She came back shortly after. We heard her shout “NO WAY” at the brochure stand over there-
targetText: Alirudi muda mfupi baadaye. Tulimsikia akipiga kelele “HAIWEZEKANI” kwenye stendi ya vijitabu pale-
speaker: Espio

sourceText: But she left back to the <style=CarName>casino car</style> before Shadow came through and locked the door.
targetText: Lakini aliondoka kurudi kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kasino</style> kabla Shadow hajapita na kufunga mlango.
speaker: Espio

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Wonder what she found? She’s obviously been on the hunt for something…)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Najiuliza alipata nini? Ni wazi amekuwa akitafuta jambo fulani…)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: After Rouge left, Shadow walked through the <style=CarName>casino car</style>...
targetText: Baada ya Rouge kuondoka, Shadow alipita kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kasino</style>...
speaker: Espio

sourceText: Then entered the <style=CarName>library car</style> and locked the door behind him.
targetText: Kisha akaingia kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style> na kufunga mlango nyuma yake.
speaker: Espio

sourceText: He insisted on showing us up at Super Monkey Ball.
targetText: Alisisitiza kutuonyesha ujuzi wake kwenye Super Monkey Ball.
speaker: Vector

sourceText: ...I guess he walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style> to the <style=CarName>casino car</style>, again locking the door behind him...
targetText: ...nadhani alipita kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style> hadi <style=CarName>gari la kasino</style>, akifunga mlango nyuma yake tena...
speaker: Vector

sourceText: ...then returned to the <style=CarName>lounge car</style> where he was meant to be stationed.
targetText: ...kisha akarudi kwenye <style=CarName>gari la mapumziko</style> ambako alipaswa kuwa amekaa.
speaker: Vector

sourceText: We sat trapped here until Amy arrived asking questions. She’s the one that told us someone murdered Sonic.
targetText: Tulikaa tumenaswa hapa hadi Amy alipofika akiuliza maswali. Yeye ndiye aliyetueleza kwamba mtu amemuua Sonic.
speaker: Espio

sourceText: Their alibi’s seem solid enough, but we should still search for clues.
targetText: Alibi zao zinaonekana imara vya kutosha, lakini bado tunapaswa kutafuta vidokezo.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: What we’re looking for is any evidence that <style=Important>proves what they’re saying is true</style>.
targetText: Tunachotafuta ni ushahidi wowote unaoonyesha kwamba <style=Important>wanachosema ni kweli</style>.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: <style=Thought>(We need to confirm Vector’s reason for leaving his post, and determine if Espio was actually in the <style=CarName>library car</style> reading.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Tunahitaji kuthibitisha sababu ya Vector kuacha kituo chake, na kujua kama Espio kweli alikuwa kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style> akisoma.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(...he hasn’t thought it through, has he.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(...hakufikiria hadi mwisho, sivyo.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: I may be a butcher, but they confiscated my meat cleaver before getting on the train…
targetText: Huenda nikawa mchinjaji, lakini walininyang'anya kisu changu cha nyama kabla ya kupanda treni…
speaker: Vector

sourceText: I’m a man of authenticity, Tails. Without a knife I’m just a chef in a ketchup-stained apron, not a butcher!
targetText: Mimi ni mtu wa uhalisia, Tails. Bila kisu mimi ni mpishi tu mwenye aproni yenye madoa ya ketchup, si mchinjaji!
speaker: Vector

sourceText: , why would you tease him like that?

sourceText: , you’ve made him a fool.
targetText: , umemfanya aonekane mjinga.

sourceText: I wasn’t entertaining him enough, it seems. Vector enjoys being social.
targetText: Inaonekana sikumburudisha vya kutosha. Vector anapenda kuwa na watu.

sourceText: Then that brings our attention to you, Espio. Rouge entered the <style=CarName>library car</style>, found something, then left.
targetText: Basi sasa tunakuelekea wewe, Espio. Rouge aliingia kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style>, akapata kitu, kisha akaondoka.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Of course he was!!
targetText: Bila shaka alikuwa!!
speaker: Vector

sourceText: Once Espio starts reading, he doesn’t stop till it’s done! I’ve seen it happen.
targetText: Espio akianza kusoma, haachi hadi amalize! Nimewahi kuona hilo.
speaker: Vector

sourceText: Espio doesn’t owe you that, ‘detective!’ Let the man live.
targetText: Espio hana deni la kukuambia hilo, ‘mpelelezi!’ Mwache mtu aishi.
speaker: Vector

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Oh I see, quiz Espio about the manual to prove he read it…)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Lo, naelewa; mhoji Espio kuhusu mwongozo kuthibitisha aliusoma…)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Which page should I quiz him on?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ni ukurasa gani nimhoji?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Important>Robotic Arms</style>. During events they can perform a variety of tasks, and are responsible for cleaning up trash and messes afterwards.
targetText: <style=Important>Mikono ya Roboti</style>. Wakati wa matukio inaweza kufanya kazi mbalimbali, na inawajibika kusafisha takataka na uchafu baadaye.
speaker: Espio

sourceText: , hit him with another one.
targetText: , muulize lingine.

sourceText: <style=Thought>(...did he just rhyme a curse at me?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(...ameweka vina vya laana kwangu?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(But he answered all my questions so calmly… that’s very impressive.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Lakini alijibu maswali yangu yote kwa utulivu sana… hilo linavutia.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: …! <style=Thought>(He always puts me on the spot!)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Daima hunibana papo kwa papo!)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Shadow walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style> to get to the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, where he set the original high score on the arcade machine.
targetText: Shadow alipita kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style> kufika kwenye <style=CarName>gari la salooni</style>, ambako aliweka alama ya kwanza ya juu kwenye mashine ya michezo.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Espio said he saw Shadow enter the <style=CarName>library car</style>… but he’s mentioned nothing about Shadow’s return.
targetText: Espio alisema alimwona Shadow akiingia kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style>… lakini hakutaja chochote kuhusu Shadow kurudi.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: He only mentions that Vector came back.
targetText: Anataja tu kwamba Vector alirudi.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: When Shadow left Knuckles and Vector in the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>, Espio was fully seated reading his book for a good while at this point.
targetText: Shadow alipowaacha Knuckles na Vector kwenye <style=CarName>gari la salooni</style>, Espio alikuwa ameketi kabisa akisoma kitabu chake kwa muda mrefu kufikia hapo.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: We know Shadow had to walk back through the <style=CarName>library car</style> when he left the <style=CarName>saloon car</style>…
targetText: Tunajua Shadow alilazimika kurudi kupitia <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style> alipoondoka kwenye <style=CarName>gari la salooni</style>…
speaker: Tails

sourceText: <style=Thought>(I can sense Espio’s desperation here… defending the argument that he was reading the entire time isn’t easy.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Naweza kuhisi kukata tamaa kwa Espio hapa… kutetea hoja kwamba alikuwa akisoma muda wote si rahisi.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: When Vector returned, he even had to tap me on the shoulder to get my attention!
targetText: Vector aliporudi, hata alilazimika kunigusa begani ili nimwangalie!
speaker: Espio

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Why doesn’t this seem right to me? Tails definitely feels like he’s on to something, but I don’t see it.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Kwa nini hili halionekani kuwa sahihi kwangu? Tails hakika amegundua jambo, lakini mimi silioni.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Was Espio simply sitting reading, or did he somehow vanish to not notice Shadow’s return to the <style=CarName>library car</style>?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Espio alikuwa ameketi tu akisoma, au alitoweka kwa namna fulani ili asitambue Shadow akirudi kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style>?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(No, I can’t interrupt Tails while he’s on to something.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Hapana, siwezi kumkatiza Tails akiwa amegundua jambo.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(I’ll let him continue this line of questioning and–)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Nitamuacha aendelee na mstari huu wa maswali na–)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Protect the passengers aboard this train… they must be taken care of!
targetText: Walinde abiria waliomo kwenye treni hii… lazima watunzwe!
speaker: Conductor

sourceText: See the exits? They’re right across from one another, a straight path.
targetText: Unaona njia za kutoka? Ziko mkabala kabisa, njia iliyonyooka.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Where could Espio have been for Shadow to not see him?
targetText: Espio angekuwa wapi ili Shadow asimuone?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: That desk is huge! I'm sure Shadow would've seen Espio if he was reading there.
targetText: Dawati hilo ni kubwa! Nina hakika Shadow angemwona Espio kama angekuwa anasoma hapo.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: That's a bookcase. I think Shadow would've noticed if Espio was climbing one of those while he walked through the <style=CarName>library car</style>.
targetText: Hiyo ni rafu ya vitabu. Nadhani Shadow angemwona Espio kama angekuwa akipanda mojawapo alipokuwa akipita kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style>.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: <style=Thought>(For Shadow to not see Espio as he was walking through the <style=CarName>library car</style>, where would Espio have been seated?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ili Shadow asimuone Espio alipokuwa akipita kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style>, Espio angekuwa ameketi wapi?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: There’s just no way you would have seen him.
targetText: Hakuna namna ungekuwa umemwona.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Sadly our work isn’t done! I have plenty of questions for Rouge, and especially Shadow.
targetText: Kwa bahati mbaya kazi yetu haijaisha! Nina maswali mengi kwa Rouge, na hasa Shadow.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Oh? It seems the door to the next car is open.
targetText: Lo? Inaonekana mlango wa gari linalofuata uko wazi.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Amy must’ve kept it open when she passed through earlier.
targetText: Amy lazima aliuacha wazi alipopita awali.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Then that’s our cue to leave! See you later, Vector and Espio.
targetText: Basi hiyo ndiyo ishara yetu ya kuondoka! Tutaonana baadaye, Vector na Espio.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: So many books on the ground… I wish we had time to pick them all up.
targetText: Vitabu vingi sana chini… Laiti tungekuwa na muda wa kuviokota vyote.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: But Rouge pulled a lot of these out too searching for something.
targetText: Lakini Rouge alitoa vingi pia akitafuta kitu.
speaker: Espio

sourceText: The spines are creasing… they’re opening too far!
targetText: Migongo inakunja… vinafunguka sana!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: <style=Thought>(He’s scavenging through all the book titles excitedly.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Anachunguza kwa hamu majina yote ya vitabu.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(He’s like a kid in a candy shop, or in this case, a genius in a train library.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Yuko kama mtoto kwenye duka la peremende, au katika hali hii, mwerevu kwenye maktaba ya treni.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(A Chao hangs precariously from a tree branch. The large text below reads ‘HANG IN THERE.’)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Chao amening'inia kwa hatari kutoka kwenye tawi la mti. Maandishi makubwa chini yanasema ‘SHIKILIA HAPO.’)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: This little Chao’s hanging there, refusing to use his wings to fly to safety, because choosing the hard way is often the most rewarding.
targetText: Chao huyu mdogo ananing'inia hapo, akikataa kutumia mabawa yake kuruka salama, kwa sababu kuchagua njia ngumu mara nyingi ndiko kunakotuza zaidi.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: That’s beautiful. If this Chao can stick to his principles and find strength, then I can too.
targetText: Hilo ni zuri. Ikiwa Chao huyu anaweza kushikilia kanuni zake na kupata nguvu, basi mimi pia naweza.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: They’re a lot of fun, honestly! Plenty of wonderful people and shops. The food can’t be beat either!
targetText: Kwa kweli ni vya kufurahisha sana! Watu na maduka mengi mazuri. Chakula pia hakina kifani!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: He’ll tell you everything about the area, and makes one scrumptious sandwich.
targetText: Atakuambia kila kitu kuhusu eneo hilo, na hutengeneza sandwichi moja tamu sana.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: <style=Thought>(This group knows everyone and has been everywhere, haven’t they??)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Kundi hili linamjua kila mtu na limekuwa kila mahali, sivyo??)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Who cares! I wouldn’t trust any book he’s written. It’s weird this is even here.
targetText: Nani anajali! Nisingeiamini kitabu chochote alichoandika. Ni ajabu hata kiko hapa.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: When Shadow left the <style=CarName>library car</style>, he locked this door on his way out.
targetText: Shadow alipoondoka kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style>, alifunga mlango huu njiani.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: There’s gotta be a reason he’s doing this… Should we make a note of it?
targetText: Lazima kuna sababu anafanya hivi… Tuandike?
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Casino Car
targetText: Gari la kasino

sourceText: Rouge, there you are! We have a lot to say to you!
targetText: Rouge, kumbe uko hapa! Tuna mengi ya kukuambia!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: We’ve visited every train car so far, and everyone’s said they’ve seen you wandering about.
targetText: Tumetembelea kila gari la treni hadi sasa, na kila mtu amesema amekuona ukizunguka huku.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: My my, talk about a warm welcome. Quick to the point, aren’t you darling?
targetText: Lo lo, huo ni ukaribisho wa uchangamfu kweli. Unaenda moja kwa moja kwenye hoja, sivyo mpenzi?
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: And I see you’ve brought the microwave master with you?
targetText: Naona umekuja na bingwa wa mikrowevu pia?
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: …Tell ‘em, Rouge. We’re gonna need the help.
targetText: …Waambie, Rouge. Tutahitaji msaada.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Blaze…?
targetText: Blaze…?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Alright. I’ve been hunting for a treasure rumored to be stored here on the train.
targetText: Sawa. Nimekuwa nikitafuta hazina inayosemekana imehifadhiwa humu kwenye treni.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: <style=Thought>(T-treasure?? They certainly didn’t tell me about treasure in the interview.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(H-hazina?? Hakika hawakunitajia hazina kwenye mahojiano.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Since I’m part business tycoon, part purveyor of fine collectibles, I knew I had to find it.
targetText: Kwa kuwa mimi ni sehemu mfanyabiashara mkubwa na sehemu mtafutaji wa vitu adimu vya kukusanya, nilijua lazima niipate.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Tell ‘em what it is, Rouge.
targetText: Mwambie ni nini, Rouge.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Alright. Well…
targetText: Sawa. Basi…
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: It’s a <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style>.
targetText: Ni <style=Important>yai la Chao la Fabergé</style>.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: But please don’t tell me you accepted Amy’s birthday invite only to find that egg…
targetText: Lakini tafadhali usiniambie ulikubali mwaliko wa siku ya kuzaliwa wa Amy kwa ajili tu ya kulipata hilo yai…
speaker: Tails

sourceText: A woman can have multiple goals! I gave Amy her <style=Important>birthday present</style> already, so everything’s well taken care of.
targetText: Mwanamke anaweza kuwa na malengo mengi! Tayari nilimpa Amy <style=Important>zawadi yake ya siku ya kuzaliwa</style>, kwa hiyo kila kitu kimetulia.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: She roped me in on the hunt immediately. I stayed here while she searched the train cars for clues.
targetText: Alinishirikisha mara moja kwenye utafutaji. Nilibaki hapa huku yeye akitafuta vidokezo kwenye mabehewa ya treni.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: I deduced that the <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style> is here, in this train car, locked in a safe.
targetText: Niligundua kwamba <style=Important>yai la Chao la Fabergé</style> liko humu, kwenye gari hili la treni, limefungiwa kwenye sefu.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: And what did you manage to find, Rouge?
targetText: Na wewe uliweza kupata nini, Rouge?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Oh, well why don’t you both take a look.
targetText: Aa, mbona nyinyi wawili msiangalie wenyewe.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I found the train’s blueprints in the <style=CarName>library car</style>, with the safe code written right on it! The score of a lifetime!
targetText: Nilipata michoro ya kiufundi ya treni kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style>, na msimbo wa sefu umeandikwa humo humo! Ugunduzi wa maisha yangu!
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: The train’s blueprints…? Please Rouge, let us see that!
targetText: Michoro ya kiufundi ya treni…? Tafadhali Rouge, tuonyeshe!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Uh uh uh, finder’s keepers, sweetheart.
targetText: La la la, aliyepata ndiye mwenye, mpenzi.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: There’s a problem. We need your assistance.
targetText: Kuna tatizo. Tunahitaji msaada wako.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: The elevator behind the security guard leads us right to the room holding the <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style>.
targetText: Lifti iliyo nyuma ya mlinzi inatupeleka moja kwa moja kwenye chumba chenye <style=Important>yai la Chao la Fabergé</style>.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: But we’re not getting anywhere without the guard’s access card.
targetText: Lakini hatufanikiwi bila kadi ya ruhusa ya mlinzi.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: We need a plan to get that card to use the elevator. And our chance of success grows with everyone’s help.
targetText: Tunahitaji mpango wa kuipata kadi hiyo ili kutumia lifti. Na nafasi yetu ya kufanikiwa huongezeka kwa msaada wa kila mtu.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: So… you want us to help you steal the <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style>?
targetText: Kwa hiyo… mnataka tuwasaidie kuiba <style=Important>yai la Chao la Fabergé</style>?
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Blaze? You don’t have a problem with this?
targetText: Blaze? Huna tatizo na hili?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: …I see no issues here. Sounds like a fine business venture.
targetText: …Sioni tatizo hapa. Linasikika kama fursa nzuri ya kibiashara.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Ah… her lore card must be influencing her decisions here.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ah… lazima kadi yake ya historia inaathiri maamuzi yake hapa.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Either that, or breaking the rules must be refreshing for a princess.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ama hilo, au kuvunja sheria lazima kuburudishe kwa binti mfalme.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: I think the only square here is you, microwave master.
targetText: Nadhani mtu pekee asiye na ladha hapa ni wewe, bingwa wa mikrowevu.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I must admit, that wasn’t the coolest thing I’ve heard someone say.
targetText: Lazima nikiri, hilo si jambo la kuvutia zaidi nililowahi kumsikia mtu akisema.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Well… I suppose if both Blaze and
targetText: Naam… nadhani ikiwa Blaze na
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Ok! Let’s get that <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style>!
targetText: Sawa! Tuchukue hilo <style=Important>yai la Chao la Fabergé</style>!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Heheh, that’s the ticket! Happy to have you both on the team.
targetText: Heheh, huo ndio mpango! Nimefurahi kuwa nyinyi wawili mko kwenye timu.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Now, we must plan.
targetText: Sasa, lazima tupange.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Oh boy… what have we gotten ourselves into…)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Lo jamani… tumejiingiza kwenye nini…)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Access to the <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style> room is behind a locked elevator door. The security guard has the access card. Do we:
targetText: Njia ya kufikia chumba cha <style=Important>yai la Chao la Fabergé</style> iko nyuma ya mlango wa lifti uliofungwa. Mlinzi ana kadi ya ruhusa. Tufanye nini:
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I can’t say I’m comfortable attacking a Chao.
targetText: Siwezi kusema ninajisikia vizuri kumshambulia Chao.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Less fun, but I agree. Let’s think about it again.
targetText: Si jambo la kufurahisha sana, lakini nakubaliana. Tufikirie tena.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I have a pair of tweezers.
targetText: Nina kibano.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I’m not giving you anything.
targetText: Sikupi chochote.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Maybe bribing isn’t the way to go…)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Labda hongo si njia ya kwenda…)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Distract them, perfect! We’re all charming enough for that to work.
targetText: Mvuruge, kamili! Sote tunavutia vya kutosha hilo lifanikiwe.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: <style=Thought>(…that was actually a really nice thing to say.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(…hilo lilikuwa jambo zuri sana kusema.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Seems they don’t know how to take a compliment.
targetText: Inaonekana hajui kupokea pongezi.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Ok, who’s distracting the security guard?
targetText: Sawa, nani atamvuruga mlinzi?
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Rouge
targetText: Rouge

sourceText: Blaze
targetText: Blaze

sourceText: Of course I’ll distract them! Who could resist my… feminine charms.
targetText: Bila shaka nitamvuruga! Nani angeweza kukataa… mvuto wangu wa kike.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I’m not sure how effective your ‘charms’ will be on a Chao…
targetText: Sina uhakika ‘mvuto’ wako utafanya kazi kwa Chao…
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Plus, your flight might prove useful. I’m not sure you being the distraction makes sense.
targetText: Zaidi ya hayo, kuruka kwako kunaweza kuwa na manufaa. Sijui kama wewe kuwa kivurugo kuna mantiki.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Oh well, fair enough! Let’s think it over again.
targetText: Basi sawa! Tufikirie tena.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I don’t like the way he said that. Veto.
targetText: Sipendi alivyosema. Nimepinga.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: I’m with Blaze, his delivery was shaky.
targetText: Niko pamoja na Blaze, namna alivyosema haikuwa thabiti.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Think you could distract the guard, Blaze?
targetText: Unaweza kumvuruga mlinzi, Blaze?
speaker: Barry

sourceText: In my life I’ve never let a single person down. I won’t falter.
targetText: Katika maisha yangu sijawahi kumwangusha mtu hata mmoja. Sitayumba.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: G-great. <style=Thought>(Her voice was so stoic. I have chills.)</style>
targetText: K-kubwa. <style=Thought>(Sauti yake ilikuwa tulivu kama jiwe. Nimesisimka.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Well, I trust her. Moving on…
targetText: Naam, namwamini. Tuendelee…
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: What’s the distraction?
targetText: Kivurugo kitakuwa nini?
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Ask the Chao about their partner and kids
targetText: Muulize Chao kuhusu mwenza na watoto wake

sourceText: Causing a ruckus, I like it a lot.
targetText: Kusababisha fujo, nalipenda sana.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Excellent, people love talking about themselves. This will easily distract the guard.
targetText: Vizuri sana, watu hupenda kujizungumzia. Hili litamvuruga mlinzi kwa urahisi.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: With the guard distracted, Rouge, how will you get the access card?
targetText: Mlinzi akiwa amevurugwa, Rouge, utapataje kadi ya ruhusa?
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Grab them and fly up to the rafters
targetText: Mkamate na uruke naye kwenye mihimili ya paa

sourceText: Pick their pocket
targetText: Mchomolee mfukoni

sourceText: I dunno, I don’t want any violence!
targetText: Sijui, sitaki vurugu yoyote!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: There won’t be any violence. I’ll just tie them up to a rafter, easy.
targetText: Hakutakuwa na vurugu. Nitamfunga tu kwenye mhimili wa paa, rahisi.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Where do we get the rope??
targetText: Tutapata wapi kamba??
speaker: Tails

sourceText: …Interesting point, maybe we should try something else.
targetText: …Hoja ya kuvutia, labda tujaribu kitu kingine.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Oh you naive, innocent soul.
targetText: Ee, wewe mwenye moyo safi usiyejua mambo.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Such a fresh face, this one. So cute.
targetText: Uso mpya kabisa huyu. Mzuri sana.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Do you suggest we take the guard out shoe shopping next?
targetText: Unapendekeza tumtoe mlinzi kwenda kununua viatu baadaye?
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I don’t think Chao wear shoes… <style=Thought>(These ladies are ruthless! I better rethink this.)</style>
targetText: Sidhani Chao huvaa viatu… <style=Thought>(Wanawake hawa hawana huruma! Bora nifikirie upya.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: I’ll snatch the access key no problem. That Chao in uniform won’t notice a thing.
targetText: Nitaiba ufunguo wa ruhusa bila tatizo. Huyo Chao aliyevaa sare hatagundua chochote.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Excellent, we can count on you Rouge!
targetText: Vizuri sana, tunaweza kukutegemea Rouge!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Try not to take anything else from them, if you can help it.
targetText: Jaribu kutochukua kitu kingine kutoka kwake, ukiweza.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: No promises.
targetText: Hakuna ahadi.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: With the card obtained, we need to get Blaze out of there.
targetText: Tukiisha kupata kadi, tunahitaji kumtoa Blaze humo.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Pretend you’re Blaze’s spouse
targetText: Jifanye mwenza wa Blaze

sourceText: Despicable. I would never allow such a thing in my kingdom.
targetText: Ni jambo la kudharauliwa. Singeweza kamwe kuruhusu jambo kama hilo katika ufalme wangu.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: The guard will go running immediately, I’m sure of it.
targetText: Mlinzi atakimbia mara moja, nina hakika.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: It’s just a little push! That Chao’s low to the ground, it won’t hurt them.
targetText: Ni msukumo mdogo tu! Chao huyo yuko chini sana, hatamuumiza.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: But if they start crying, it'd bring unwanted attention to us.
targetText: Lakini akianza kulia, hilo litatuletea usikivu usiotakiwa.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Decent point. Let's think of something else.
targetText: Hoja nzuri. Tufikirie jambo lingine.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: …then you’d be marrying into the royal family. What is your heritage?
targetText: …basi ungeolewa katika familia ya kifalme. Asili yako ni ipi?
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Any war crimes I should know about?
targetText: Kuna uhalifu wowote wa kivita ninaopaswa kujua?
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: You dress far too plain. You would need a complete refashioning immediately.
targetText: Unavaa kwa kawaida kupita kiasi. Utahitaji kubadilishwa mtindo kabisa mara moja.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Interesting, you give up far too easily as well. We’d have to work on your fortitude.
targetText: Cha kuvutia, pia unakata tamaa kwa urahisi mno. Itabidi tufanyie kazi uthabiti wako.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: And just like that, we all make it in the elevator! Inside, we:
targetText: Na hivyo hivyo, sote tunaingia kwenye lifti! Ndani yake, tunafanya:
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Oh no, one last security measure we didn’t account for!
targetText: Lo, kuna hatua moja ya mwisho ya usalama ambayo hatukuizingatia!
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: What do we do about the mechanical arms attacking from the ceiling?
targetText: Tufanye nini kuhusu mikono ya mitambo inayoshambulia kutoka kwenye dari?
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: High-five each of them
targetText: Gongesha kiganja na kila mmoja.

sourceText: Have Tails disable them
targetText: Mwache Tails azizime

sourceText: Tie them into one big knot
targetText: Ifunge iwe fundo moja kubwa

sourceText: The end of those arms are claws! I’m not touching ‘em.
targetText: Mwisho wa mikono hiyo ni makucha! Siyagusi.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: My high fives aren’t given away willy-nilly. They are to be cherished.
targetText: Kugongesha mkono kwangu hakutolewi ovyo ovyo. Kunapaswa kuthaminiwa.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: I don’t think my hands would survive a high five from them… let’s rethink this.
targetText: Sidhani mikono yangu ingepona kugongeshwa na hayo… tufikirie upya.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: <style=Thought>(They all humored my suggestion… how oddly polite of them.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Wote wamefuata wazo langu… wamekuwa na adabu kwa namna ya ajabu.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: I should be able to disengage them, I’ll just need some time.
targetText: Nitaweza kuizima, nitahitaji tu muda.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Well that leads us nicely to our next question…
targetText: Basi hilo linatupeleka vizuri kwenye swali letu linalofuata…
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: My shoes don’t have laces. Does anyone here know how to tie a knot?
targetText: Viatu vyangu havina kamba. Kuna yeyote hapa anayejua kufunga fundo?
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Yes.
targetText: Ndiyo.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Well… no.
targetText: Basi… hapana.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Oh no, Tails is taking a while and the arms are tightening their grip!
targetText: Lo, Tails anachukua muda na mikono inazidi kutubana!
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Cry and hope they sympathize
targetText: Lia na utumaini watakuhurumia

sourceText: Darlings, I’m happy to say, this plan is perfect.
targetText: Wapenzi, ninafurahi kusema mpango huu ni kamili.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: If everyone is ready… it’s time to execute!
targetText: Kila mtu akiwa tayari… ni wakati wa kuutekeleza!
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I’m ready. Let’s begin.
targetText: Niko tayari. Tuanze.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: <style=Thought>(No one seems to suspect anything, and the security guard is back at their post.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Hakuna anayeonekana kushuku chochote, na mlinzi amerudi kwenye kituo chake.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Hope they subdued the drink coaster fiend ok.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Natumaini walimdhibiti mwendawazimu wa vizibo vya vinywaji.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Thank you both for your assistance. That hunt was exactly the thrill I was seeking.
targetText: Asanteni nyote wawili kwa msaada wenu. Utafutaji huo ulikuwa msisimko hasa niliokuwa nautafuta.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Now, Rouge…
targetText: Sasa, Rouge…
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Rouge?
targetText: Rouge?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: <style=Thought>(She’s completely absorbed in that bedazzled Chao…)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Amezama kabisa kwenye huyo Chao aliyepambwa kwa vito…)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: What, what? What is it, darling?
targetText: Nini, nini? Kuna nini, mpenzi?
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: About those blueprints… Now that you’re done with them, maybe we could take a look?
targetText: Kuhusu ile michoro ya kiufundi… Sasa kwa kuwa umemalizana nayo, labda tunaweza kuiangalia?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: …While I appreciate your assistance, it’s as I said. Finders keepers.
targetText: …Ingawa nathamini msaada wenu, ni kama nilivyosema. Aliyepata ndiye mwenye.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I’ll need them a little longer in case I missed any other treasures. But I promise to let you take a peek later.
targetText: Nitazihitaji kwa muda mrefu kidogo iwapo nimekosa hazina nyingine. Lakini naahidi nitakuacha uziangalie baadaye.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I don’t want to sound ungrateful, but I’m sure you get it, sweetheart.
targetText: Sitaki kuonekana nisiye na shukrani, lakini nina hakika unaelewa, mpenzi.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: <style=Thought>(But I don’t think there’s any reasoning with her. She’s more powerful than me.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Lakini sidhani kuna hoja ya kubishana naye. Ana nguvu kuniliko.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Before you go, Shadow gave me and Rouge one of these. He passed through earlier.
targetText: Kabla hujaenda, Shadow alinipa mimi na Rouge moja ya hizi. Alipita hapa awali.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Let me unlock the door so you can continue forward.
targetText: Ngoja nifungue mlango ili muendelee mbele.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Y’know, we’ve had a lot of people mention you, Rouge…
targetText: Unajua, watu wengi wametutajia kuhusu wewe, Rouge…
speaker: Tails

sourceText: He’s unpredictable, that one. Good luck to you.
targetText: Huyo hatabiriki. Bahati njema kwenu.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: The door’s unlocked, both of you stay safe. Thanks again.
targetText: Mlango umefunguliwa, nyinyi wawili jihadharini. Asanteni tena.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: The capabilities of these robot arms are quite spectacular. I’m impressed everytime we see them!
targetText: Uwezo wa mikono hii ya roboti ni wa kushangaza sana. Ninavutiwa kila mara tunapoiona!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: I can’t help but wonder how they’re controlled…
targetText: Siwezi kuacha kujiuliza… inadhibitiwaje?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: At the very least, things operate much smoother with them here! I wouldn’t worry about it.
targetText: Angalau mambo yanafanyika kwa urahisi zaidi ikiwa iko hapa! Singekuwa na wasiwasi.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Yeah that is true, they’re very versatile!
targetText: Ndiyo, ni kweli, zinaweza kufanya mambo mengi!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: My Dad told me that when he met my mother, he would drive to her work two hours away every Tuesday with a flower from his garden.
targetText: Baba yangu aliniambia alipokutana na mama yangu, alikuwa akiendesha gari hadi kazini kwake umbali wa saa mbili kila Jumanne akiwa na ua kutoka bustanini kwake.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: She quickly agreed to a date, and when she arrived at the restaurant, she found two dozen roses waiting for her.
targetText: Mara moja alikubali kwenda miadi, na alipofika kwenye mgahawa, alikuta waridi dazani mbili zikimsubiri.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=legaltext>The phenomenon whereby a person is reluctant to abandon a strategy or course of action because they have invested heavily in it, even when it is clear that abandonment would be more beneficial?</style>
targetText: <style=legaltext>Hali ambayo mtu husita kuacha mkakati au hatua fulani kwa sababu amewekeza sana humo, hata inapokuwa wazi kuwa kuiacha kungekuwa na manufaa zaidi?</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: That’s Dr. Eggman’s logo… I suppose he does deal a lot with casinos.
targetText: Hiyo ni nembo ya Dkt. Eggman… Nadhani anahusika sana na kasino.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: He’s an evil scientist that’s always caused trouble for us and Sonic.
targetText: Yeye ni mwanasayansi mwovu ambaye daima ametusababishia sisi na Sonic matatizo.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Pulling off that heist was much more enjoyable than the rest of these casino games.
targetText: Kufanikisha wizi huo kulifurahisha zaidi kuliko michezo hii mingine ya kasino.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Do you think you could go over your alibi again for us, Blaze?
targetText: Unafikiri unaweza kutueleza tena alibi yako, Blaze?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: When Amy began the murder mystery, what did you do?
targetText: Amy alipoanza fumbo la mauaji, ulifanya nini?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Sure, we left the <style=CarName>dining car</style> and Rouge pulled me aside to talk about the <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style>.
targetText: Sawa, tuliondoka kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kulia chakula</style> na Rouge akanitoa pembeni ili kuzungumza kuhusu utafutaji wa <style=Important>yai la Chao la Fabergé</style>.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: We walked and talked to the <style=CarName>casino car</style>, where we then went our separate ways. I scoped around and discovered the egg was here.
targetText: Tulitembea na kuzungumza hadi <style=CarName>gari la kasino</style>, ambako kisha tulienda njia zetu tofauti. Nilitazama huku na huku na kugundua yai lilikuwa hapa.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: After that, I played the slot machines. The train did a sudden jolt which was odd, but I didn’t leave the car.
targetText: Baada ya hapo, nilicheza mashine za kamari. Treni ilitetemeka ghafla, jambo lililokuwa la ajabu, lakini sikuondoka kwenye gari.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: I gave Amy her <style=Important>present</style> when she stopped by. Shadow passed through as well, but it was brief. He gave me the exit key and left.
targetText: Nilimpa Amy <style=Important>zawadi yake</style> alipopita. Shadow pia alipita, lakini kwa muda mfupi. Alinipa ufunguo wa kutokea kisha akaondoka.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: I do, actually. I kept winning, so I saved the cashout voucher. You can take a look.
targetText: Ninao, kwa kweli. Niliendelea kushinda, kwa hiyo nilihifadhi vocha ya kutoa fedha. Unaweza kuangalia.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: I’m just naturally lucky, I suppose.
targetText: Labda nina bahati ya asili tu.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: <style=Thought>(That smirk! She’s so self aware!)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Tabasamu hilo! Anajitambua sana!)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: W-well, thank you for your time, Blaze.
targetText: B-basi, asante kwa muda wako, Blaze.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Anytime. And Tails, do tell Cream I said hi, won't you?
targetText: Wakati wowote. Na Tails, mwambie Cream nimesalimia, tafadhali.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Thanks again for your help earlier. Now what can I do for you darlings?
targetText: Asante tena kwa msaada wako wa awali. Sasa naweza kuwasaidia nini, wapendwa?
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Do you think you could go over your alibi again for us, Rouge?
targetText: Unafikiri unaweza kutueleza tena alibi yako, Rouge?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: When Amy began the murder mystery, what did you do?
targetText: Amy alipoanza fumbo la mauaji, ulifanya nini?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Well… once Amy paired Blaze and I up, I immediately roped her in on my <style=Important>Fabergé Chao egg</style> hunt.
targetText: Basi… Amy aliponiunganisha na Blaze, mara moja nilimshirikisha kwenye utafutaji wangu wa <style=Important>yai la Chao la Fabergé</style>.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: We split up at the <style=CarName>casino car</style>, and I went searching for the blueprints.
targetText: Tulitengana kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kasino</style>, nami nikaenda kutafuta ramani.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I walked back through the <style=CarName>library</style> and <style=CarName>saloon cars</style> till I found it in the <style=CarName>library car</style>.
targetText: Nilirudi kupitia <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style> na <style=CarName>gari la salooni</style> hadi nilipoipata kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style>.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Sonic? No, I don’t believe so. I remember him in the <style=CarName>dining car</style> at the beginning.
targetText: Sonic? Hapana, sidhani. Namkumbuka akiwa kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kulia chakula</style> mwanzoni.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Listen, plenty of people saw me poking around, and I have the blueprints on me.
targetText: Sikiliza, watu wengi waliniona nikichunguza huku na kule, na nina ramani hizi.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I hardly had time to chase Sonic down, murder him, and find the blueprints myself.
targetText: Sikuwa na muda wa kutosha kumfuatilia Sonic, kumuua, na kutafuta ramani mwenyewe.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: We appreciate you answering our questions, Rouge. You take care now.
targetText: Tunashukuru kwa kujibu maswali yetu, Rouge. Uwe salama sasa.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Likewise, darling.
targetText: Vivyo hivyo, mpenzi.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I’m content for now, thank you.
targetText: Kwa sasa nimeridhika, asante.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: The whole “maybe the egg is a bomb” thing destroyed my appetite.
targetText: Jambo lote la “labda yai ni bomu” liliharibu hamu yangu ya kula.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: Yeah, you're a very um… animated person.
targetText: Ndiyo, wewe ni mtu wa, ee… uchangamfu sana.
speaker: Blaze

sourceText: What a paltry menu. Not a lot of options, sweetie.
targetText: Menyu ya kusikitisha namna gani. Hakuna chaguo nyingi, mpenzi.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: I think I’ll have to pass.
targetText: Nadhani nitaachana nayo.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Sure, if I need a bag of chips I’ll holler.
targetText: Sawa, nikihitaji mfuko wa chipsi nitaita.
speaker: Rouge

sourceText: Lounge Car
targetText: Gari la mapumziko

sourceText: I know you won’t talk, but I know exactly why you’ve been locking those doors!
targetText: Najua hutazungumza, lakini najua hasa kwa nini umekuwa ukifunga milango hiyo!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: No reason is convincing enough! It’s inconceivable what you did!
targetText: Hakuna sababu inayoshawishi vya kutosha! Ulichofanya hakifikiriki!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Well it seems Amy already knows, so ask her.
targetText: Basi inaonekana Amy tayari anajua, muulize yeye.
speaker: Shadow

sourceText: Hmph!
targetText: Hmph!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: <style=Thought>(An appointment? Who wants to meet with him?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Miadi? Nani anataka kukutana naye?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(It took every muscle in his body to agree with Tails.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ilimbidi atumie kila msuli mwilini kukubaliana na Tails.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Glad you two finally caught up!
targetText: Nimefurahi nyinyi wawili hatimaye mmetufikia!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I'm so close to getting the scoop of the century, I can feel it!
targetText: Niko karibu sana kupata habari moto ya karne, naweza kuihisi!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Oh? A question for moi? You know the <style=Important>journalist can't be the murderer</style>, remember?
targetText: Lo? Swali kwangu? Unajua <style=Important>mwandishi wa habari hawezi kuwa muuaji</style>, unakumbuka?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Simple, the birthday girl gets what the birthday girl wants.
targetText: Rahisi, msichana wa siku ya kuzaliwa hupata anachotaka.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: And I don’t go anywhere without my hammer!
targetText: Na mimi siendi popote bila nyundo yangu!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Now, no more questions! When you’re ready to challenge Shadow, talk to him. I’ll be ready.
targetText: Sasa hakuna maswali zaidi! Mkiwa tayari kumhoji Shadow, zungumzeni naye. Nitakuwa tayari.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I'm surprised it took you so long to get here, I thought you wanted to save Sonic.
targetText: Ninashangaa imewachukua muda mrefu kufika hapa, nilidhani mlitaka kumwokoa Sonic.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Just a hot tip, but all will be revealed in due time.
targetText: Dokezo motomoto tu, lakini yote yatafunuliwa kwa wakati unaofaa.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I think I’ll be shedding a big light on this whole case!
targetText: Nadhani nitaangaza mwanga mkubwa kwenye kesi hii nzima!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: No way! Journalist reporter Amy Rose is always first to reveal a scoop.
targetText: Haiwezekani! Mwandishi wa habari Amy Rose daima huwa wa kwanza kufichua habari.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: When you’re ready to challenge Shadow, talk to him. Then I’ll be ready.
targetText: Ukiwa tayari kumhoji Shadow, zungumza naye. Kisha nitakuwa tayari.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: <style=Thought>(I’m so curious what it is… she seems confident.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ninataka kujua ni nini… anaonekana mwenye ujasiri.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: C’mon, to the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>!
targetText: Twende kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kondakta</style>!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I wonder what we’ll find there.
targetText: Najiuliza tutapata nini huko.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Admittedly I haven’t seen the conductor in awhile… hope he’s alright.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Kwa kweli sijamwona Kondakta kwa muda… natumaini yuko salama.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: I’m not ordering a single thing till we get birthday cake.
targetText: Siagizi kitu hata kimoja hadi tupate keki ya siku ya kuzaliwa.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Cake first, dinner after. Otherwise I’ll get full on dinner and can’t have any cake!
targetText: Keki kwanza, chakula baadaye. Vinginevyo nitashiba chakula na sitapata keki!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: It just makes sense!
targetText: Linaeleweka tu!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: –and I know why.
targetText: –na najua kwa nini.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Heheh, time to reveal my hot tip.
targetText: Heheh, wakati wa kufichua dokezo langu motomoto.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Hope everyone’s ready for a scoop found by yours truly!
targetText: Natumaini kila mtu yuko tayari kwa habari niliyopata mwenyewe!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: According to the map, the next car is the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>, where Sonic was stationed.
targetText: Kulingana na ramani, gari linalofuata ni <style=CarName>gari la kondakta</style>, ambako Sonic alikuwa amepangiwa.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: This door, right here in the <style=CarName>lounge car</style>, is the only door that leads to the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>. Following?
targetText: Mlango huu, hapa kwenye <style=CarName>gari la mapumziko</style>, ndio mlango pekee unaoelekea kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kondakta</style>. Mnafuata?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: So Shadow was locking all the doors for one reason and one reason alone…
targetText: Kwa hiyo Shadow alikuwa akifunga milango yote kwa sababu moja tu…
speaker: Amy

sourceText: To keep Sonic… from escaping the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>!
targetText: Kumzuia Sonic… asitoroke kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kondakta</style>!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I sure do! He locked the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>, then locked all the others so one locked door wasn’t suspicious.
targetText: Ndiyo kabisa! Alifunga <style=CarName>gari la kondakta</style>, kisha akafunga mengine yote ili mlango mmoja uliofungwa usiwe na mashaka.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Well, my source can back up these claims. They will remain anonymous, but I think the point stands.
targetText: Basi, chanzo changu kinaweza kuunga mkono madai haya. Kitabaki bila kutajwa, lakini nadhani hoja bado ni thabiti.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: My source claims they never saw Sonic again after he went to the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>. Why?
targetText: Chanzo changu kinadai hakumwona tena Sonic baada ya kwenda kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kondakta</style>. Kwa nini?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Because he was trapped… and couldn’t leave the <style=CarName>conductor’s car</style>!
targetText: Kwa sababu alinaswa… na hakuweza kuondoka kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kondakta</style>!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I’ll play along and follow this train of logic, Amy.
targetText: Nitaambatana na mfuatano huu wa mantiki, Amy.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: A… secret passage??
targetText: Njia… ya siri??
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Hm. This adjusts my theory a bit.
targetText: Hmm. Hii inarekebisha nadharia yangu kidogo.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: So Shadow murdered Sonic in the <style=CarName>conductor car</style>, but then thought the crime scene being so close to his station was suspicious.
targetText: Kwa hiyo Shadow alimuua Sonic kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kondakta</style>, lakini kisha akafikiri eneo la uhalifu lililokuwa karibu sana na kituo chake lingekuwa la kutiliwa shaka.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Shadow picked up Sonic, locked the door to the <style=CarName>conductor car</style> on the way out, and dropped the body off at the <style=CarName>dining car</style>.
targetText: Shadow alimnyanyua Sonic, akafunga mlango wa <style=CarName>gari la kondakta</style> njiani, na akaacha mwili kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kulia chakula</style>.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I am! But of course, this is just a theory.
targetText: Ninamshutumu! Lakini bila shaka, hii ni nadharia tu.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I, uh, don’t have any evidence to back this up. Other than my hot scoop!
targetText: Mimi, ee, sina ushahidi wa kuunga mkono hili. Mbali na habari yangu motomoto!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: …then how did Espio and Vector not see him?
targetText: …basi Espio na Vector hawakumwonaje?
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Well, um…
targetText: Basi, ee…
speaker: Amy

sourceText: I suppose it would be hard to sneak around two people…
targetText: Nadhani ingekuwa vigumu kujificha karibu na watu wawili…
speaker: Amy

sourceText: See! Things are falling into place.
targetText: Unaona! Mambo yanaanza kukaa sawa.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: But, what about Espio?
targetText: Lakini, vipi kuhusu Espio?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Espio reading in the library checks out, that’s what he told me too.
targetText: Espio akisoma kwenye maktaba inaendana, ndivyo alivyoniambia pia.
speaker: Amy

sourceText: He’s lying.
targetText: Anadanganya.
speaker: Shadow

sourceText: I spent some time looking for Espio… but he was not there. He was not in the <style=CarName>library car</style>.
targetText: Nilitumia muda nikimtafuta Espio… lakini hakuwa huko. Hakuwa kwenye <style=CarName>gari la maktaba</style>.
speaker: Shadow

sourceText: Like I’d believe you! You’re currently my number one suspect!
targetText: Kama vile ningekuamini! Kwa sasa wewe ndiye mshukiwa wangu namba moja!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Why were you even searching for Espio, huh?
targetText: Kwa nini hata ulikuwa ukimtafuta Espio, eh?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: If you must know, I needed to give him a key.
targetText: Ukitaka kujua, nilihitaji kumpa ufunguo.
speaker: Shadow

sourceText: As if! Why would a locksmith be giving away his keys?
targetText: Kama vile! Kwa nini fundi wa kufuli awe anagawa funguo zake?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: …! I didn’t know that! Shadow’s been… passing out keys?
targetText: …! Sikujua hilo! Shadow amekuwa… akigawa funguo?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: … What evidence supports Shadow’s claim that he was giving keys away?
targetText: … Ni ushahidi gani unaounga mkono dai la Shadow kwamba alikuwa akigawa funguo?

sourceText: <style=Thought>(What piece of evidence helps show that Shadow was giving away his keys?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ni kipande gani cha ushahidi kinachosaidia kuonyesha Shadow alikuwa akigawa funguo zake?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: …! No way…
targetText: …! Haiwezekani…
speaker: Amy

sourceText: W-well, what of his own key? Couldn’t one of those be for him?
targetText: B-basi, ufunguo wake mwenyewe? Mmoja wa hizo haungeweza kuwa wake?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: … tch! Interesting…
targetText: … tch! Inavutia…
speaker: Amy

sourceText: So let’s say Shadow’s telling the truth, then what?
targetText: Kwa hiyo tuseme Shadow anasema ukweli, halafu nini?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: If Shadow didn’t murder Sonic and bring him to the <style=CarName>dining car</style>…
targetText: Ikiwa Shadow hakumuua Sonic na kumleta kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kulia chakula</style>…
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Then what possible reason could he have for locking all the doors?
targetText: Basi angekuwa na sababu gani ya kufunga milango yote?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: <style=Thought>(She’s right… Her theory is strong. Tails and I certainly haven’t presented any possibilities.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Yuko sahihi… Nadharia yake ina nguvu. Mimi na Tails hakika hatujatoa uwezekano wowote.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(...! WHY DOES HE KEEP INCLUDING ME, TOO?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(...! KWA NINI ANAENDELEA KUNIJUMUISHA PIA?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: First, Amy, I just have one question for you.
targetText: Kwanza, Amy, nina swali moja tu kwako.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Oh, most everyone, yeah! Everyone’s been so sweet!
targetText: Lo, karibu kila mtu, ndiyo! Kila mtu amekuwa mwema sana!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Just, um, Shadow and Sonic haven’t given me anything yet. But that’s ok! Just them being here is enough!
targetText: Ee, Shadow na Sonic bado hawajanipa chochote. Lakini ni sawa! Kuwapo kwao hapa kunatosha!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Understood, thank you Amy.
targetText: Nimeelewa, asante Amy.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: We know Shadow walked through every train car locking the exits. And he gave everyone stationed in the cars a key.
targetText: Tunajua Shadow alipita kwenye kila gari la treni akifunga njia za kutoka. Na akampa kila mtu aliyepangiwa kwenye magari ufunguo.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: …except for you, me, and Amy.
targetText: …isipokuwa wewe, mimi, na Amy.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: <style=Thought>(...! That’s right, the conductor gave Amy her birthday key, not Shadow.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(...! Ni kweli, Kondakta alimpa Amy ufunguo wa siku ya kuzaliwa, si Shadow.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(So… why would he lock all the doors and not give us a key?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Kwa hiyo… kwa nini afunge milango yote na asitupatie ufunguo?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Maybe! But Shadow knew Amy, you and I started in the <style=CarName>dining car</style>.
targetText: Labda! Lakini Shadow alijua wewe, Amy, na mimi tulianza kwenye <style=CarName>gari la kulia chakula</style>.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: He could have given us keys if he wanted to.
targetText: Angeweza kutupa funguo kama angetaka.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: I think Shadow was trying to keep Amy away.
targetText: Nadhani Shadow alikuwa akijaribu kumweka Amy mbali.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: wHAT? EXCUSE ME?
targetText: NINI? SAMAHANI?
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Shadow would never do that! It’s my birthday!
targetText: Shadow hangefanya hivyo kamwe! Ni siku yangu ya kuzaliwa!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: You know it’s my birthday, right? Don’t you, Shadow??
targetText: Unajua ni siku yangu ya kuzaliwa, sivyo? Si hivyo, Shadow??
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Ah–! How dare…
targetText: Ah–! Unathubutu…
speaker: Amy

sourceText: If Shadow was trying to keep me away, prove it! You’ve been so thorough or whatever!

targetText: Tukateleza tukaingia kwenye mkokoteni wa manunuzi wa mzee mmoja.
speaker: Tails

sourceText: Let's go <style=Important>interrogate</style> Amy and find out what really happened!
targetText: Twende <style=Important>tumhoji</style> Amy na tujue kilichotokea kweli!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: SONIC!!
targetText: SONIC!!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Someone murdered my darling Sonic!
targetText: Mtu amemuua Sonic wangu mpendwa!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Looks like the game’s begun. I’m finding out who did this, at once!
targetText: Inaonekana mchezo umeanza. Nitatafuta aliyefanya hivi mara moja!
speaker: Amy

sourceText: Amy, wait! I wanna figure out who did this too!
targetText: Amy, subiri! Mimi pia nataka kujua aliyefanya hivi!
speaker: Tails

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Is he actually hurt?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Kweli ameumia?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(He’s… not moving…are these wounds on him genuine?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ha… sogei… majeraha haya aliyo nayo ni ya kweli?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: <style=Thought>(My hand’s on his wrist but I don’t sense a pulse… am I doing this right? What in the world is going on?)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Mkono wangu uko kwenye kifundo chake lakini sihisi mapigo… ninafanya hivi sawa? Nini hasa kinaendelea?)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: These guests are incredibly renowned, which means they must be remarkably rich.
targetText: Wageni hawa ni maarufu sana, maana yake lazima wawe matajiri sana.
speaker: Conductor

sourceText: So I leave their care to you,
targetText: Kwa hiyo ninakukabidhi jukumu la kuwahudumia,
speaker: Conductor

sourceText: <style=Thought>(I need to catch up to Amy and Tails and get to the bottom of this. Even if this is part of the game, I just can’t risk it.)</style>
targetText: <style=Thought>(Lazima nimfuate Amy na Tails na kufikia kiini cha hili. Hata kama ni sehemu ya mchezo, siwezi kuhatarisha.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: My head… Tails? Amy? Ah…
targetText: Kichwa changu… Tails? Amy? Ah…
speaker: Barry

sourceText: I miss when it was just showing us the weather.
targetText: Natamani kama ungekuwa bado ukituonyesha hali ya hewa tu.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: … I miss the yellow glow already.
targetText: …tayari ninaukosa mwangaza wa njano.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Who the heck are you? Don’t talk to me.
targetText: Wewe ni nani jamani? Usizungumze nami.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: <style=Thought>(Ah… ignoring that…)</style> They certainly didn’t talk about you in my interview!
targetText: <style=Thought>(Ah… nikipuuza hilo…)</style> Hakika hawakuzungumzia wewe kwenye mahojiano yangu!
speaker: Barry

sourceText: My involvement isn’t well known, civilian.
targetText: Ushiriki wangu haujulikani sana, raia.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: Let me guess… Another death egg, Doctor Predictable?
targetText: Ngoja nikisie… Death Egg nyingine, Daktari Anayetabirika?
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: The people fear giant spheres! It’s science!
targetText: Watu wanaogopa matufe makubwa! Ni sayansi!
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: Let’s cut to the chase. Where are our friends?
targetText: Tufikie hoja. Marafiki zetu wako wapi?
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Judging by my security cameras, your pathetic friends are all locked in the cars they were stationed in.
targetText: Kwa kuangalia kamera zangu za usalama, marafiki zenu wa kusikitisha wamefungiwa wote kwenye magari waliyokuwa wamepangiwa.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: You see, the capability of a badnik is normally very basic, just kill Sonic The Hedgehog.
targetText: Unaona, uwezo wa badnik huwa wa msingi sana, kumuua tu Sonic The Hedgehog.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: I like to make my badniks compete against one another from time to time. It’s good for productivity.
targetText: Napenda kuwafanya badnik wangu washindane mara kwa mara. Ni vizuri kwa uzalishaji.
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: So I instituted a <style=Important>bounty</style> upon my army of badniks!
targetText: Kwa hiyo niliweka <style=Important>tuzo</style> kwa jeshi langu la badnik!
speaker: Eggman

sourceText: …he always knows how to get under my skin.
targetText: …daima anajua jinsi ya kunikasirisha.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Aw man!
targetText: Ah jamani!
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: The windows are all covered up now… I never got to look at the pretty views…
targetText: Madirisha yote yamefunikwa sasa… sikuwahi kupata nafasi ya kuangalia mandhari mazuri…
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Amy was saying the train’s sights couldn’t be beat! I was excited!
targetText: Amy alisema mandhari za treni hazina kifani! Nilifurahi!
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: After all we’ve been through, I’m sure the train company will offer you some kind of coupon for another visit.
targetText: Baada ya yote tuliyopitia, nina hakika kampuni ya treni itakupa kuponi ya ziara nyingine.
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Quick, pick some up and toss it over your shoulder.
targetText: Haraka, chukua kidogo na uitupe juu ya bega lako.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: O-ok! <style=Thought>(A pinch of salt and… there, over the shoulder.)</style>
targetText: S-sawa! <style=Thought>(Chumvi kidogo na… hapo, juu ya bega.)</style>
speaker: Barry

sourceText: Perfect, I can already tell our luck is turning around.
targetText: Vizuri kabisa, tayari naweza kuhisi bahati yetu inabadilika.
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: …? What was his ticket doing here?
targetText: …? Tiketi yake ilikuwa inafanya nini hapa?
speaker: Sonic

sourceText: Maybe he confused a napkin for his ticket, and his ticket for a napkin?
targetText: Labda alichanganya leso na tiketi yake, na tiketi yake na leso?
speaker: Barry

sourceText: HA, hope his ticket didn’t have a ketchup stain.
targetText: HA, natumaini tiketi yake haikuwa na doa la ketchup.
speaker: Sonic
